summary: Master the fundamentals of information management with our training course. Equip yourself with the skills to excel in data handling and organization.
lede: Information management covers how organizations create, organize, protect, retrieve, retain, and dispose of information. For professionals responsible for operational records and documentation, the course offers practical ways to make information easier to find and keep it accurate and appropriately controlled. Topics include classifying sensitive material, setting retention and naming rules, managing versions and access, improving metadata and search, and capturing knowledge for handovers.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who are integral to the management and organization of critical information within their organizations.
modules: Information Security and Privacy in Practice
Managing Email, Collaboration Tools, and Digital Workflows
prerequisites: Participants should have basic computer skills and familiarity with their organization's document and data handling processes.
